title: Audiences, dancing and admission price
summary: Most people danced; Jones listened rather than danced. Admission was twenty-five to forty cents.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Well you used to sit around and listen to the bands then. You didn't go to the dances to dance much, huh?
I wasn't dancing on the couch to see the people going to the dance. Oh yeah.
Most everybody danced when they went in though. Oh yeah.
Nearly all. Nearly all of them. Women and men. But I never did care about dancing.
How much did they charge to get in a dance those days?
How much money did they get in?
Twenty-five. Forty cents. Now, now it doesn't be fifty cents. Mm-hmm.
